name: Kyouran ~Kurutta Seikatsu~
source:
Reiko lives a happy family life, but it eventually gets boring. One day she sees an advertisement on the site she frequents, and that pushes her back to the days of masturbation with toys.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
玲子原本过着幸福的家庭生活，却渐渐对此感到厌倦。一天，她在经常浏览的网站上看到一则广告，由此重新回到使用玩具自慰的日子。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
